evidence.claim: Transaction 3478782 triggered an alert based on a legacy real-time risk score of 0.79, although the bank's calibrated second-generation model score is low at 0.115 with a historical fraud rate of 21.17%.
The transaction amount ($292.36) exceeds the holder's prior maximum of $121.32, but it is an isolated transaction with no card-testing sequence or rapid authorizations in the 10-day card window.

Holder C11891-K1|NA|-305 has zero prior transactions in confirmed fraud cases, and transaction 3478782 is consistent with the holder's baseline product C, online channel, and hotmail.com email domain observed in transaction 3043555.
Transaction 3478782 has no device ID, no proxy, and card C11891-K1 has ring_id -1 with no connection to any suspicious device ring.
Recipient email domain hotmail.com shows an un-elevated lift of 0.97 across 795 transactions in the 7-day window, indicating no shared-origin fraud cluster.

Similar closed cases CC-4158 and CC-3639 indicate that isolated transactions flagged solely by high risk scores without corroborating graph anomalies were confirmed legitimate cardholder activity and cleared.

case.summary: Transaction 3478782 ($292.36, online) on card C11891-K1 was flagged due to an elevated legacy real-time risk score of 0.79. In contrast, the calibrated second-generation model scored the transaction at 0.115, corresponding to a historical fraud rate of only 21.17%. The holder identity shows no history of confirmed fraud and matches baseline channel, product code, and email domain attributes. There are no device anomalies, proxy indicators, card-testing patterns, or associations with known fraud rings. The transaction was determined to be legitimate cardholder activity and closed without fraud.
